== English Virtual Original comparison ==
Protection changes from not being made immediately lost in the weapons phase to pre-loss replacement for your starships during the weapons segment. The latter applies to a loss action in that window irrespective of the wording that causes the loss. The separate Lost Pile cost and rest-of-turn attrition immunity agree.
